meta.title: Old Song
meta.description: Amidst gunsmoke and ruins, the song of the battlefield plunges people into an endless nightmare.

units.rawText:
I do not want the children to hear,<|>
Cries of anger drowned out by cold gunshots.

I do not want the children to hear,
Cries of anger drowned out by cold gunshots.

units.rawText: So mother, this dove of mine might never return to its nest.

units.rawText: But do not weep,
units.displayText: But do not weep,

spans.text: But do not weep,

units.rawText: For I know the spirit of freedom will always spread its wings in the light of daybreak.

units.displayText: >>Chapter//Scars, Wings, Daisies...

units.rawText: In the Oasis' lounge.
units.displayText: In the Oasis' lounge.

spans.text: In the Oasis' lounge.

units.rawText: The morning sunlight pours in through the windows as Clotho enjoys a leisurely breakfast.
units.displayText: The morning sunlight pours in through the windows as Clotho enjoys a leisurely breakfast.

spans.text: The morning sunlight pours in through the windows as Clotho enjoys a leisurely breakfast.

units.rawText: Do you want some music to whet your appetite? Let me see, how about something jazz or blues?
units.displayText: Do you want some music to whet your appetite? Let me see, how about something jazz or blues?

spans.text: Do you want some music to whet your appetite? Let me see, how about something jazz or blues?

units.rawText: The light of daybreak ill-suits your clamor, Hel. The gentle sunlight, the fresh scent of grass and the vigor of life is the best depiction of the dawn.
units.displayText: The light of daybreak ill-suits your clamor, Hel. The gentle sunlight, the fresh scent of grass and the vigor of life is the best depiction of the dawn.

spans.text: The light of daybreak ill-suits your clamor, Hel. The gentle sunlight, the fresh scent of grass and the vigor of life is the best depiction of the dawn.

units.rawText: How about a little ditty, then?
units.displayText: How about a little ditty, then?

spans.text: How about a little ditty, then?

units.rawText: Hel switches her neural cloud to broadcast mode. A brief silence later, her vocalizer modules begin playing a European nursery rhyme.
units.displayText: Hel switches her neural cloud to broadcast mode. A brief silence later, her vocalizer modules begin playing a European nursery rhyme.

spans.text: Hel switches her neural cloud to broadcast mode. A brief silence later, her vocalizer modules begin playing a European nursery rhyme.

units.rawText: The music fills the room with gentle warmth, making listeners think of snow melting and flowers blossoming across a certain little European city.
units.displayText: The music fills the room with gentle warmth, making listeners think of snow melting and flowers blossoming across a certain little European city.

spans.text: The music fills the room with gentle warmth, making listeners think of snow melting and flowers blossoming across a certain little European city.

units.rawText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?
units.displayText: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?

spans.text: When you left the flowers withered, when you left summer gave way to autumn. Those who ran to the battlefield; where do you rest now?

units.rawText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.
units.displayText: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

spans.text: Whether the world is lush and green, whether the world is a stark pale white. Whether it is night or day, I will be waiting here for you to return.

units.rawText: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.
units.displayText: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

spans.text: May the gunsmoke have faded when we meet again.

units.rawText: May the fires have burned out when we meet again.
units.displayText: May the fires have burned out when we meet again.

spans.text: May the fires have burned out when we meet again.

units.rawText: Though it is indistinct at times, the music still resonates with the memories of good old days, painting the lounge in quiet shades of melancholy.
units.displayText: Though it is indistinct at times, the music still resonates with the memories of good old days, painting the lounge in quiet shades of melancholy.

spans.text: Though it is indistinct at times, the music still resonates with the memories of good old days, painting the lounge in quiet shades of melancholy.

units.rawText: The song draws Centaureissi, who is making flower arrangements nearby, and she slowly walks over to Clotho's table.
units.displayText: The song draws Centaureissi, who is making flower arrangements nearby, and she slowly walks over to Clotho's table.

spans.text: The song draws Centaureissi, who is making flower arrangements nearby, and she slowly walks over to Clotho's table.

units.rawText: This song...
units.displayText: This song...

spans.text: This song...

units.rawText: Hehehe, do you like it, Centaureissi?
units.displayText: Hehehe, do you like it, Centaureissi?

spans.text: Hehehe, do you like it, Centaureissi?

units.rawText: Ah, I believe this song came from a place where you once lived...
units.displayText: Ah, I believe this song came from a place where you once lived...

spans.text: Ah, I believe this song came from a place where you once lived...

units.rawText: Yes, I should have heard this song before... But...
units.displayText: Yes, I should have heard this song before... But...

spans.text: Yes, I should have heard this song before... But...

units.rawText: Centaureissi recalls a certain war-torn town in winter, broadcasts through ancient speakers, the endless sounds of gunfire, explosions which shake the very world and the gloomy, overcast sky...
units.displayText: Centaureissi recalls a certain war-torn town in winter, broadcasts through ancient speakers, the endless sounds of gunfire, explosions which shake the very world and the gloomy, overcast sky...

spans.text: Centaureissi recalls a certain war-torn town in winter, broadcasts through ancient speakers, the endless sounds of gunfire, explosions which shake the very world and the gloomy, overcast sky...

units.rawText: It seems so familiar... But why... Why can't I remember anything...
units.displayText: It seems so familiar... But why... Why can't I remember anything...

spans.text: It seems so familiar... But why... Why can't I remember anything...

units.rawText: Countless images flit through Centaureissi's mind. The fragments of memory scatter like they were blown away, and she cannot hold onto them.
units.displayText: Countless images flit through Centaureissi's mind. The fragments of memory scatter like they were blown away, and she cannot hold onto them.

spans.text: Countless images flit through Centaureissi's mind. The fragments of memory scatter like they were blown away, and she cannot hold onto them.

units.rawText: Her core heats up. The image from her memories overlaps with the view of the lounge and her footsteps begin to wobble.
units.displayText: Her core heats up. The image from her memories overlaps with the view of the lounge and her footsteps begin to wobble.

spans.text: Her core heats up. The image from her memories overlaps with the view of the lounge and her footsteps begin to wobble.

units.rawText: Ugh... My head, it hurts...
units.displayText: Ugh... My head, it hurts...

spans.text: Ugh... My head, it hurts...

units.rawText:
Thud!
Centaureissi falls to the ground like a wind-blown tree. Her eyes wander and lose their focus...
units.displayText:
Thud!

units.rawText: Centaureissi? Centaureissi! Centau...
units.displayText: Centaureissi? Centaureissi! Centau...

spans.text: Centaureissi? Centaureissi! Centau...

units.displayText: At the Oasis' Medical Department.

spans.text: At the Oasis' Medical Department.

units.rawText: Clotho looks anxiously at Centaureissi, who is lying unconscious inside a medical capsule. Beside her, Antonina is conducting an analysis of her condition.
units.displayText: Clotho looks anxiously at Centaureissi, who is lying unconscious inside a medical capsule. Beside her, Antonina is conducting an analysis of her condition.

spans.text: Clotho looks anxiously at Centaureissi, who is lying unconscious inside a medical capsule. Beside her, Antonina is conducting an analysis of her condition.

units.rawText: The sound of keystrokes fills everyone with a sense of powerlessness. With a sigh, Antonina shakes her head and stops typing.
units.displayText: The sound of keystrokes fills everyone with a sense of powerlessness. With a sigh, Antonina shakes her head and stops typing.

spans.text: The sound of keystrokes fills everyone with a sense of powerlessness. With a sigh, Antonina shakes her head and stops typing.

units.rawText: How is she?
units.displayText: How is she?

spans.text: How is she?

units.rawText: I've got good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?
units.displayText: I've got good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?

spans.text: I've got good news and bad news. Which do you want to hear first?

units.rawText: Start with the bad news. I've prepared myself for the worst.
units.displayText: Start with the bad news. I've prepared myself for the worst.

spans.text: Start with the bad news. I've prepared myself for the worst.

units.rawText: Alright. The bad news is that past damage to Centaureissi's body and neural cloud has created a lot of dark zones in her memories.
units.displayText: Alright. The bad news is that past damage to Centaureissi's body and neural cloud has created a lot of dark zones in her memories.

spans.text: Alright. The bad news is that past damage to Centaureissi's body and neural cloud has created a lot of dark zones in her memories.

units.rawText: These dark zones can be triggered during conversation by certain pieces of key content. The neural cloud module cannot retrieve the relevant data, causing Centaureissi to crash.
units.displayText: These dark zones can be triggered during conversation by certain pieces of key content. The neural cloud module cannot retrieve the relevant data, causing Centaureissi to crash.

spans.text: These dark zones can be triggered during conversation by certain pieces of key content. The neural cloud module cannot retrieve the relevant data, causing Centaureissi to crash.

units.rawText: What's the good news, then?
units.displayText: What's the good news, then?

spans.text: What's the good news, then?

units.rawText: These dark zones can be fixed. We can help Centaureissi organize the relevant memories and repair the dark zones.
units.displayText: These dark zones can be fixed. We can help Centaureissi organize the relevant memories and repair the dark zones.

spans.text: These dark zones can be fixed. We can help Centaureissi organize the relevant memories and repair the dark zones.

units.rawText: Can we do that?
units.displayText: Can we do that?

spans.text: Can we do that?

units.rawText: ...It'll be difficult, but it's worth trying.
units.displayText: ...It'll be difficult, but it's worth trying.

spans.text: ...It'll be difficult, but it's worth trying.

units.rawText: Memory data can be likened to a Doll's dreams. Centaureissi is currently gripped by a nightmare and cannot break free.
units.displayText: Memory data can be likened to a Doll's dreams. Centaureissi is currently gripped by a nightmare and cannot break free.

spans.text: Memory data can be likened to a Doll's dreams. Centaureissi is currently gripped by a nightmare and cannot break free.

units.rawText: What we can do is simulate Centaureissi's dreams, repair and complete the memories, and then rescue her from the dark zone.
units.displayText: What we can do is simulate Centaureissi's dreams, repair and complete the memories, and then rescue her from the dark zone.

spans.text: What we can do is simulate Centaureissi's dreams, repair and complete the memories, and then rescue her from the dark zone.

units.rawText: ...So we'll be entering Centaureissi's memories and helping her defeat her nightmares, then?
units.displayText: ...So we'll be entering Centaureissi's memories and helping her defeat her nightmares, then?

spans.text: ...So we'll be entering Centaureissi's memories and helping her defeat her nightmares, then?

units.rawText: I can try. I once worked with her on the battlefield. Guiding souls to where they belong is also part of my job description.
units.displayText: I can try. I once worked with her on the battlefield. Guiding souls to where they belong is also part of my job description.

spans.text: I can try. I once worked with her on the battlefield. Guiding souls to where they belong is also part of my job description.

units.rawText: Yup, yup, yup. We've been through all kinds of crap together. I'm sure this bond will help in awakening her memories.
units.displayText: Yup, yup, yup. We've been through all kinds of crap together. I'm sure this bond will help in awakening her memories.

spans.text: Yup, yup, yup. We've been through all kinds of crap together. I'm sure this bond will help in awakening her memories.

units.rawText: ...No. I'll think of a way to help Centaureissi.
units.displayText: ...No. I'll think of a way to help Centaureissi.

spans.text: ...No. I'll think of a way to help Centaureissi.

units.rawText: Clotho, both you and Centaureissi are very important to me. I don't want to lose you, so you should leave a dangerous task like this to me.
units.displayText: Clotho, both you and Centaureissi are very important to me. I don't want to lose you, so you should leave a dangerous task like this to me.

spans.text: Clotho, both you and Centaureissi are very important to me. I don't want to lose you, so you should leave a dangerous task like this to me.

units.rawText: Are you sure you want to do this, Professor?
units.displayText: Are you sure you want to do this, Professor?

spans.text: Are you sure you want to do this, Professor?

units.rawText: While you can attempt multiple connections to a memory domain, encountering a severe incident will cause a data desync.
units.displayText: While you can attempt multiple connections to a memory domain, encountering a severe incident will cause a data desync.

spans.text: While you can attempt multiple connections to a memory domain, encountering a severe incident will cause a data desync.

units.rawText: Also, you're a human being... If we lose your data, I might have to end up selling you off to another sector as a Diggcoin miner.
units.displayText: Also, you're a human being... If we lose your data, I might have to end up selling you off to another sector as a Diggcoin miner.

spans.text: Also, you're a human being... If we lose your data, I might have to end up selling you off to another sector as a Diggcoin miner.

units.rawText: Urgh, please don't put pressure on me at a time like this.
units.displayText: Urgh, please don't put pressure on me at a time like this.

spans.text: Urgh, please don't put pressure on me at a time like this.

units.rawText: The star of destiny darkens for those who choose the wrong path.
units.displayText: The star of destiny darkens for those who choose the wrong path.

spans.text: The star of destiny darkens for those who choose the wrong path.

units.rawText: ...Professor, are you sure you want to take this risk yourself?
units.displayText: ...Professor, are you sure you want to take this risk yourself?

spans.text: ...Professor, are you
sure
you want to take this risk yourself?

units.rawText: Yes. I won't let you take this risk so long as I have the strength to protect you.
units.displayText: Yes. I won't let you take this risk so long as I have the strength to protect you.

spans.text: Yes. I won't let you take this risk so long as I have the strength to protect you.

units.rawText: That is why I and the Oasis exist.
units.displayText: That is why I and the Oasis exist.

spans.text: That is why I and the Oasis exist.

units.rawText: The people before me look at each other and smile, and then Hel's deep voice booms forth.
units.displayText: The people before me look at each other and smile, and then Hel's deep voice booms forth.

spans.text: The people before me look at each other and smile, and then Hel's deep voice booms forth.

units.rawText: Professor, if anything really does happen to your neural cloud, I'll make sure my interior temperature and humidity are properly tweaked so you may rest in peace.
units.displayText: Professor, if anything really does happen to your neural cloud, I'll make sure my interior temperature and humidity are properly tweaked so you may rest in peace.

spans.text: Professor, if anything really does happen to your neural cloud, I'll make sure my interior temperature and humidity are properly tweaked so you may rest in peace.

units.rawText: Er... Thanks, I guess.
units.displayText: Er... Thanks, I guess.

spans.text: Er... Thanks, I guess.

units.rawText: Hel, that's going too far. Professor, a person's dreams can be both incoherent and complex, and they may also record the saddest parts of her past.
units.displayText: Hel, that's going too far. Professor, a person's dreams can be both incoherent and complex, and they may also record the saddest parts of her past.

spans.text: Hel, that's going too far. Professor, a person's dreams can be both incoherent and complex, and they may also record the saddest parts of her past.

units.rawText: No matter what dreams may come, I hope you will return safely from them.
units.displayText: No matter what dreams may come, I hope you will return safely from them.

spans.text: No matter what dreams may come, I hope you will return safely from them.

units.rawText: ...Yes, I promise.
units.displayText: ...Yes, I promise.

spans.text: ...Yes, I promise.

units.rawText: Antonina quickly enters the relevant data for the memory domain and connects her computer to the medical capsule.
units.displayText: Antonina quickly enters the relevant data for the memory domain and connects her computer to the medical capsule.

spans.text: Antonina quickly enters the relevant data for the memory domain and connects her computer to the medical capsule.

units.displayText: System initialization complete. Operational data normal...

units.rawText: We've warmed up the capsule program. You may enter when ready.
units.displayText: We've warmed up the capsule program. You may enter when ready.

spans.text: We've warmed up the capsule program. You may enter when ready.

units.rawText: Got it. Keep an eye on Centaureissi's condition from the outside. Guiding her neural cloud to fix the dark zones will require her effort as well as mine.
units.displayText: Got it. Keep an eye on Centaureissi's condition from the outside. Guiding her neural cloud to fix the dark zones will require her effort as well as mine.

spans.text: Got it. Keep an eye on Centaureissi's condition from the outside. Guiding her neural cloud to fix the dark zones will require her effort as well as mine.

units.rawText: Relax. If I detect any abnormalities from you or Centaureissi, I'll cut the program ASAP and wake you up.
units.displayText: Relax. If I detect any abnormalities from you or Centaureissi, I'll cut the program ASAP and wake you up.

spans.text: Relax. If I detect any abnormalities from you or Centaureissi, I'll cut the program ASAP and wake you up.

units.rawText: ...I just hope I don't end up as a Diggcoin miner card.
units.displayText: ...I just hope I don't end up as a Diggcoin miner card.

spans.text: ...I just hope I don't end up as a Diggcoin miner card.

units.rawText: Oh? Are you doubting my technical skills, Professor?
units.displayText: Oh? Are you doubting my technical skills, Professor?

spans.text: Oh? Are you doubting my technical skills, Professor?

units.rawText: Heh, I was just kidding. Take care of everyone, Antonina.
units.displayText: Heh, I was just kidding. Take care of everyone, Antonina.

spans.text: Heh, I was just kidding. Take care of everyone, Antonina.

units.rawText: Relax. You've always been able to bring everyone back from even the most dire situation. I'm sure it'll be the same this time.
units.displayText: Relax. You've always been able to bring everyone back from even the most dire situation. I'm sure it'll be the same this time.

spans.text: Relax. You've always been able to bring everyone back from even the most dire situation. I'm sure it'll be the same this time.

units.rawText: So come back soon. Everyone's waiting to celebrate the New Year with you.
units.displayText: So come back soon. Everyone's waiting to celebrate the New Year with you.

spans.text: So come back soon. Everyone's waiting to celebrate the New Year with you.

units.rawText: I will.
units.displayText: I will.

spans.text: I will.

units.rawText: I take a deep breath and then lie down in the medical capsule. The hatch slides shut, blocking off my line of sight, and my mind slowly drifts into a new, alien world.
units.displayText: I take a deep breath and then lie down in the medical capsule. The hatch slides shut, blocking off my line of sight, and my mind slowly drifts into a new, alien world.

units.displayText: Neural cloud simulation system activated. Now generating simulated memory domain. Loading consciousness carrier medium... Consciousness upload at 45%...

units.displayText: If I come back safely... I should recommend Burbank Denki's newest coffee machine to Persicaria...

units.displayText: 99%, 100%... Consciousness carrier loading complete.

units.rawText: As the voice of the system announcement fades away, the world around me changes completely.
units.displayText: As the voice of the system announcement fades away, the world around me changes completely.

spans.text: As the voice of the system announcement fades away, the world around me changes completely.

units.rawText: I thought I'd be dropped into some European officer's garden having a cup of English tea with a slice of chiffon cake as I awaited the appearance of the maid Doll.
units.displayText: I thought I'd be dropped into some European officer's garden having a cup of English tea with a slice of chiffon cake as I awaited the appearance of the maid Doll.

spans.text: I thought I'd be dropped into some European officer's garden having a cup of English tea with a slice of chiffon cake as I awaited the appearance of the maid Doll.

units.rawText: However, the scenery before me is... a little different from what I anticipated.
units.displayText: However, the scenery before me is... a little different from what I anticipated.

spans.text: However, the scenery before me is... a little different from what I anticipated.

units.rawText: Scattered Doll limbs are strewn all around me and the thick, cloying scent of rust and metal fills my mouth and nose.
units.displayText: Scattered Doll limbs are strewn all around me and the thick, cloying scent of rust and metal fills my mouth and nose.

spans.text: Scattered Doll limbs are strewn all around me and the thick, cloying scent of rust and metal fills my mouth and nose.

units.rawText: Electrical humming and crackling fill my ears as the dizziness and discomfort slowly fade away. All I see around me are burned-out ruins that have clearly been through war and bloodshed.
units.displayText: Electrical humming and crackling fill my ears as the dizziness and discomfort slowly fade away. All I see around me are burned-out ruins that have clearly been through war and bloodshed.

spans.text: Electrical humming and crackling fill my ears as the dizziness and discomfort slowly fade away. All I see around me are burned-out ruins that have clearly been through war and bloodshed.

units.rawText: This is no officer's backyard; rather, it is a place I've known well since I was a child, a battlefield teeming with screams and despair.
units.displayText: This is no officer's backyard; rather, it is a place I've known well since I was a child, a battlefield teeming with screams and despair.

spans.text: This is no officer's backyard; rather, it is a place I've known well since I was a child, a battlefield teeming with screams and despair.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily and pants) Talk about a rough start... Urgh!
units.displayText: (Coughs heavily and pants) Talk about a rough start... Urgh!

spans.text: (Coughs heavily and pants) Talk about a rough start... Urgh!

units.rawText: As I get to my feet from inside a pile of Doll corpses, the pain in my chest and left arm surge through my body.
units.displayText: As I get to my feet from inside a pile of Doll corpses, the pain in my chest and left arm surge through my body.

spans.text: As I get to my feet from inside a pile of Doll corpses, the pain in my chest and left arm surge through my body.

units.rawText: Dammit! What the hell was that! I think I saw someone standing up!
units.displayText: Dammit! What the hell was that! I think I saw someone standing up!

spans.text: Dammit! What the hell was that! I think I saw someone standing up!

units.rawText: What the heck are you talking about? Didn't you verify that pile of assholes just now? They're all corpses, aren't they!
units.displayText: What the heck are you talking about? Didn't you verify that pile of assholes just now? They're all corpses, aren't they!

spans.text: What the heck are you talking about? Didn't you verify that pile of assholes just now? They're all corpses, aren't they!

units.rawText: Screw you, it's true! Something's moving in that pile of rubble over there!
units.displayText: Screw you, it's true! Something's moving in that pile of rubble over there!

spans.text: Screw you, it's true! Something's moving in that pile of rubble over there!

units.rawText: ...I didn't expect someone to be standing guard over here.
units.displayText: ...I didn't expect someone to be standing guard over here.

spans.text: ...I didn't expect someone to be standing guard over here.

units.rawText: Judging by their uniforms and gear, they are clearly not on the same side as the owner of this body.
units.displayText: Judging by their uniforms and gear, they are clearly not on the same side as the owner of this body.

spans.text: Judging by their uniforms and gear, they are clearly not on the same side as the owner of this body.

units.rawText: The sound of the soldiers' footsteps presses in. All I can do is lower myself and use the rubble to block the enemy's line of sight.
units.displayText: The sound of the soldiers' footsteps presses in. All I can do is lower myself and use the rubble to block the enemy's line of sight.

spans.text: The sound of the soldiers' footsteps presses in. All I can do is lower myself and use the rubble to block the enemy's line of sight.

units.rawText: Kachak! The sound of a round chambering is exceptionally loud in the silence of this broad street.
units.displayText: Kachak! The sound of a round chambering is exceptionally loud in the silence of this broad street.

spans.text: Kachak! The sound of a round chambering is exceptionally loud in the silence of this broad street.

units.rawText: Dang it! I see somebody over there!
units.displayText: Dang it! I see somebody over there!

spans.text: Dang it! I see somebody over there!

units.rawText: I quickly compile a plan for what I'll do if I'm spotted.
units.displayText: I quickly compile a plan for what I'll do if I'm spotted.

spans.text: I quickly compile a plan for what I'll do if I'm spotted.

units.rawText: If the worst comes to be, I'll need to get out of the way before they open fire, use the terrain to hide, and then take their weapons from them before waiting for a chance to escape.
units.displayText: If the worst comes to be, I'll need to get out of the way before they open fire, use the terrain to hide, and then take their weapons from them before waiting for a chance to escape.

spans.text: If the worst comes to be, I'll need to get out of the way before they open fire, use the terrain to hide, and then take their weapons from them before waiting for a chance to escape.

units.rawText: ...The plan seems simple enough, but whether or not this beat-up body of mine can carry it out remains to be seen.
units.displayText: ...The plan seems simple enough, but whether or not this beat-up body of mine can carry it out remains to be seen.

spans.text: ...The plan seems simple enough, but whether or not this beat-up body of mine can carry it out remains to be seen.

units.rawText: A shout from nearby interrupts my train of thought.
units.displayText: A shout from nearby interrupts my train of thought.

spans.text: A shout from nearby interrupts my train of thought.

units.rawText: Hey, over here! That bastard's running that way!
units.displayText: Hey, over here! That bastard's running that way!

spans.text: Hey, over here! That bastard's running that way!

units.rawText: Get him! Don't let him escape!
units.displayText: Get him! Don't let him escape!

spans.text: Get him! Don't let him escape!

units.rawText: After the lead soldier gives his order, the men behind him ready their weapons and follow him into the alley to capture their prey. I wait for the sound of footsteps to fade away before struggling out of the rubble.
units.displayText: After the lead soldier gives his order, the men behind him ready their weapons and follow him into the alley to capture their prey. I wait for the sound of footsteps to fade away before struggling out of the rubble.

spans.text: After the lead soldier gives his order, the men behind him ready their weapons and follow him into the alley to capture their prey. I wait for the sound of footsteps to fade away before struggling out of the rubble.

units.rawText: So they found someone else, huh...
units.displayText: So they found someone else, huh...

spans.text: So they found someone else, huh...

units.rawText: Now's not the time to push myself. This body's arm is hurt, so fighting with a gun will be difficult.
units.displayText: Now's not the time to push myself. This body's arm is hurt, so fighting with a gun will be difficult.

spans.text: Now's not the time to push myself. This body's arm is hurt, so fighting with a gun will be difficult.

units.rawText: Since I don't know what's going on, I should start by finding a place to hide.
units.displayText: Since I don't know what's going on, I should start by finding a place to hide.

spans.text: Since I don't know what's going on, I should start by finding a place to hide.

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to relocate to a nearby abandoned building, I hear a shout from the alley.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to relocate to a nearby abandoned building, I hear a shout from the alley.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to relocate to a nearby abandoned building, I hear a shout from the alley.

units.rawText: Christ, it's just a goddamn kid! We spend all damn day searching for the garrison troops and intelligence personnel and all we get is this shit.
units.displayText: Christ, it's just a goddamn kid! We spend all damn day searching for the garrison troops and intelligence personnel and all we get is this shit.

spans.text: Christ, it's just a goddamn kid! We spend all damn day searching for the garrison troops and intelligence personnel and all we get is this shit.

units.rawText: The soldiers curse as they shove a skinny boy into their midst.
units.displayText: The soldiers curse as they shove a skinny boy into their midst.

spans.text: The soldiers curse as they shove a skinny boy into their midst.

units.rawText: He seems to be only eight or nine years old. He's kind of short and his hair is messy.
units.displayText: He seems to be only eight or nine years old. He's kind of short and his hair is messy.

spans.text: He seems to be only eight or nine years old. He's kind of short and his hair is messy.

units.rawText: You wasted our time, you little shit! Do you know how valuable it is!
units.displayText: You wasted our time, you little shit! Do you know how valuable it is!

spans.text: You wasted our time, you little shit! Do you know how valuable it is!

units.rawText: Forget that! Let's just do him in right now!
units.displayText: Forget that! Let's just do him in right now!

spans.text: Forget that! Let's just do him in right now!

units.rawText: They mercilessly point their guns at the boy. Faced with this unassailable despair, all the boy can do is tremble and close his eyes.
units.displayText: They mercilessly point their guns at the boy. Faced with this unassailable despair, all the boy can do is tremble and close his eyes.

spans.text: They mercilessly point their guns at the boy. Faced with this unassailable despair, all the boy can do is tremble and close his eyes.

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: There is a gunshot, but the pain that the boy expects does not come. The boy opens his eyes to find himself curled in warm arms, having narrowly dodged the Reaper's scythe.
units.displayText: There is a gunshot, but the pain that the boy expects does not come. The boy opens his eyes to find himself curled in warm arms, having narrowly dodged the Reaper's scythe.

spans.text: There is a gunshot, but the pain that the boy expects does not come. The boy opens his eyes to find himself curled in warm arms, having narrowly dodged the Reaper's scythe.

units.rawText: What the heck? Where did this bastard come from?!
units.displayText: What the heck? Where did this bastard come from?!

spans.text: What the heck? Where did this bastard come from?!

units.rawText: Wait, that face... It looks kind of familiar...
units.displayText: Wait, that face... It looks kind of familiar...

spans.text: Wait, that face... It looks kind of familiar...

units.rawText: ?! It's... It's the commander of that spec-ops intelligence team! I know you! You're dead! We killed you! We killed you!
units.displayText: ?! It's... It's the commander of that spec-ops intelligence team! I know you! You're dead! We killed you! We killed you!

spans.text: ?! It's... It's the commander of that spec-ops intelligence team! I know you! You're dead! We killed you! We killed you!

units.rawText: Whew, made it.
units.displayText: Whew, made it.

spans.text: Whew, made it.

units.rawText: The left side of my chest hurts from the exertion. Although my sense of reason is telling me to flee, my body has always had a habit of acting faster than my brain could keep up.
units.displayText: The left side of my chest hurts from the exertion. Although my sense of reason is telling me to flee, my body has always had a habit of acting faster than my brain could keep up.

spans.text: The left side of my chest hurts from the exertion. Although my sense of reason is telling me to flee, my body has always had a habit of acting faster than my brain could keep up.

units.rawText: Even though I barely managed to dodge that gunshot with a jump just now, I know I've never been the lucky sort.
units.displayText: Even though I barely managed to dodge that gunshot with a jump just now, I know I've never been the lucky sort.

spans.text: Even though I barely managed to dodge that gunshot with a jump just now, I know I've never been the lucky sort.

units.rawText: I can't put any strength into my left hand now. All I can do is barely hold on to the boy.
units.displayText: I can't put any strength into my left hand now. All I can do is barely hold on to the boy.

spans.text: I can't put any strength into my left hand now. All I can do is barely hold on to the boy.

units.rawText: Damn, who would have thought we'd run into a jackass who'd walk right up to us... Fine then, to hell with both of you!
units.displayText: Damn, who would have thought we'd run into a jackass who'd walk right up to us... Fine then, to hell with both of you!

spans.text: Damn, who would have thought we'd run into a jackass who'd walk right up to us... Fine then, to hell with both of you!

units.rawText: Hng...
units.displayText: Hng...

spans.text: Hng...

units.rawText: In this critical moment, a silver-gleaming dagger slices through the air and neatly severs the soldier's carotid vein.
units.displayText: In this critical moment, a silver-gleaming dagger slices through the air and neatly severs the soldier's carotid vein.

spans.text: In this critical moment, a silver-gleaming dagger slices through the air and neatly severs the soldier's carotid vein.

units.rawText: Before the second soldier can respond, the knife's owner is already upon him. After felling him with a side kick, she swings her knife and ends the enemy's howl of pain.
units.displayText: Before the second soldier can respond, the knife's owner is already upon him. After felling him with a side kick, she swings her knife and ends the enemy's howl of pain.

spans.text: Before the second soldier can respond, the knife's owner is already upon him. After felling him with a side kick, she swings her knife and ends the enemy's howl of pain.

units.rawText: Aiiiieeee! Who's that?!
units.displayText: Aiiiieeee! Who's that?!

spans.text: Aiiiieeee! Who's that?!

units.rawText: My gaze travels down the cramped alleyway and I spot a glint of light at the alley entrance.
units.displayText: My gaze travels down the cramped alleyway and I spot a glint of light at the alley entrance.

spans.text: My gaze travels down the cramped alleyway and I spot a glint of light at the alley entrance.

units.rawText: The person standing there is a girl with blonde hair and blue eyes, elegantly dressed and glaring at the soldiers in the alley with a cold, keen look in her eyes.
units.displayText: The person standing there is a girl with blonde hair and blue eyes, elegantly dressed and glaring at the soldiers in the alley with a cold, keen look in her eyes.

spans.text: The person standing there is a girl with blonde hair and blue eyes, elegantly dressed and glaring at the soldiers in the alley with a cold, keen look in her eyes.

units.rawText: No matter the situation, seeing her with a G36 rifle in hand has always been reassuring.
units.displayText: No matter the situation, seeing her with a G36 rifle in hand has always been reassuring.

spans.text: No matter the situation, seeing her with a G36 rifle in hand has always been reassuring.

units.rawText: Pardon my lateness.
units.displayText: Pardon my lateness.

spans.text: Pardon my lateness.

units.rawText: The girl's face matches up with my memories, but her attire is completely different from her usual elegant maid's uniform.
units.displayText: The girl's face matches up with my memories, but her attire is completely different from her usual elegant maid's uniform.

spans.text: The girl's face matches up with my memories, but her attire is completely different from her usual elegant maid's uniform.

units.rawText: This outfit of yours...
units.displayText: This outfit of yours...

spans.text: This outfit of yours...

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang-bang-bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang-bang-bang!

spans.text: Bang-bang-bang!

units.rawText: A hail of gunfire interrupts the girl's words. She quickly raises her rifle and counterattacks, her figure leaping swiftly through the darkness as shell casings and enemy soldiers drop to the ground at the same time.
units.displayText: A hail of gunfire interrupts the girl's words. She quickly raises her rifle and counterattacks, her figure leaping swiftly through the darkness as shell casings and enemy soldiers drop to the ground at the same time.

spans.text: A hail of gunfire interrupts the girl's words. She quickly raises her rifle and counterattacks, her figure leaping swiftly through the darkness as shell casings and enemy soldiers drop to the ground at the same time.

units.rawText: Once the fighting is over, she looks back at me, her voice as stern and clear as I've always remembered.
units.displayText: Once the fighting is over, she looks back at me, her voice as stern and clear as I've always remembered.

spans.text: Once the fighting is over, she looks back at me, her voice as stern and clear as I've always remembered.

units.rawText: I am <color=orange>Centaureissi</color>, a Doll dispatched from SIT - the special intelligence team, requesting permission to join your unit.
units.displayText: I am Centaureissi, a Doll dispatched from SIT - the special intelligence team, requesting permission to join your unit.
